relevance_note: Single-patient case report (letter) of an ITGB2-deficient boy: 'flow-cytometry revealed total absence (0%) of neutrophil expressed CD18 ... consistent with severe leukocyte adhesion deficiency type 1 (LAD-1)', with two ITGB2 alleles described.
method_note: Read the whole Markdown by hand; a short Python script only assembled the JSON and copied Table 1 row segments (Neutrophils, CD4*, CD8*, C019* rows) from the file, checked against the table. Table 1 (unnumbered in the Markdown, after the Figure 1 legend) has columns: row label, '.(D%S6)' (garbled header, values look like reference ranges), 'LAD-1' (the patient) and 'Control'; OCR-type errors in the table (e.g. 'C019*', 'TES', 'NO') are left as printed and not used beyond the four cell-count rows. HTML entity: the Markdown prints '>' in 'c.817G>A'; spans keep '>', values decode it to '>' as printed in the article. Protein string recorded as printed without the period ('pGly273Arg'). Inheritance taken from the authors' allele attribution ('on the paternal allele'; deletion 'encompassing the maternal ITGB2 gene'); the paper does not state that the parents were tested, so parental_testing_statement is 'not reported'. Zygosity left 'not reported': the paper never names it (missense on one allele, 1 Mb deletion on the other) and rule 8 forbids inferring it. The parents ('unrelated healthy Danish parents') get no rows: they are neither stated as tested nor affected and no individual-level data beyond 'healthy' is given. Age at diagnosis not stated (referral at 11 months; diagnosis age not given). Age at last evaluation taken as 24 months (bone marrow transplantation, 52 weeks post-vaccination); the text also says 'now aged 12 months' at the third vaccination. 'His infectious history until then was characterized solely by recurrent bacterial skin infections' was not used to exclude specific other infections (sepsis, otitis, pneumonia, fungal etc.), as it names no specific feature; checklist items left 'not reported'. 'normal concentrations of IgA, IgM and IgG' recorded as excluded 'abnormal IgA, IgM and IgG concentrations' (D-27). No stacked cells used (the pTFH row '15.0/22.8/21.3' is a time series for one person and was not extracted). No contradictions found.
